description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. Before a night out at the casino, the 2 outdoor swimming pools are a perfect way to relax and recharge. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. At The Ritz-Carlton, Turks & Caicos, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and ATM/banking services. Free valet parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 155 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily.

name: Beaches Turks & Caicos Resort Villages & Spa
description: This family-friendly luxury beach hotel offers a variety of accommodations, including 614 rooms and family suites, spread across four distinct villa groups featuring French, Italian, and Caribbean architectural styles. Guests enjoy access to a 24-hour reception, hairdressing salon, games room, kids' club, cafe, 16 specialty restaurants, 12 bars with unlimited premium drinks, and a nightclub. Conference facilities, laundry service, and parking are also available. Standard rooms feature a king-size bed, private bathroom, telephone, ethernet internet access, satellite TV, CD clock radio, hi-fi system, safe, fridge, tea and coffee making facilities, ironing set, and individually controlled air conditioning. Situated along 19 km of pristine beach with clear turquoise waters, the hotel boasts six swimming pools (three with swim-up bars), a dedicated toddler pool, and a water park. Guests can relax on the sun terrace or participate in activities such as aerobics, gym workouts, or indulge in the sauna, hot tubs, massage, and spa treatments. A wide array of water sports, including diving, surfing, windsurfing, sailing, canoeing, and pedal boating, is available, as well as tennis, table tennis, pool/snooker, and beach volleyball. The hotel also provides entertainment programs for both adults and children. Airport transfers are included for Sandals and Beaches resorts. Online check-in is required. Sandals and Beaches resorts honor customer loyalty points.

Grace Bay Park is a short 7-minute bus ride away. Offering stunning ocean views, this hotel features luxurious accommodations and impressive conference facilities. A children's playground and kid's club are also available.

Indulge in massages and facials at the full-service spa or take advantage of the three outdoor pools, tennis court, and fitness center. The 114 air-conditioned rooms feature microwaves, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable TV. Dine at Hemingway's, grab a snack at the deli, or unwind at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. Additional amenities include concierge services, babysitting, and a business center.

Sugary white beaches, abundant underwater sea life and turquoise waters are the perfect setting for romantic strolls and especially ideal for wedding celebrations. Featuring a myriad of luxurious accommodation options, guests will be assured a memorable stay at this exclusive resort. Guest rooms count with spectacular oceanfront views and oversized window walls, as well as a stylish and charming design. The generous balconies offer breathtaking views of Grace Bay and welcome soothing Caribbean breezes inside. Visitors will appreciate the excellent on-site dining and leisure facilities to make guests' stay even more privileged.

name: The Shore Club Turks & Caicos
description: At The Shore Club, the only limit is your imagination. Defined by a spirit of relaxed luxury, refreshing adventure, healthy indulgence, and exclusive accessibility, it's a place where you can do exactly what you desire: a place to write your own story. Long Bay Beach—the most private stretch of Providenciales, the most sought after location of the Turks and Caicos Islands—offers the best of both worlds, a stunning, secluded beach just minutes away from Provo's town center. Unparalleled service in an informal atmosphere, The Shore Club boasts a bespoke luxury resort experience, impeccably designed by the Hartling Group, the team behind the award-winning Palms in Grace Bay. With three spectacular restaurants, sophisticated bars, and unique pools, as well as smart on-site shopping, a world-class gym and spa, a complimentary Kids Club, and a wide range water activities.

name: Villa Renaissance
description: Pamper yourself with massages, body treatments, and facials at this beachfront hotel in Providenciales. Enjoy recreational amenities including an outdoor pool, tennis court, and fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and take advantage of concierge and wedding services. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. The hotel also offers a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self-parking is available onsite. Each of the 36 individually decorated guest rooms provides complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, a washer/dryer, and daily housekeeping service. A short walk from Providenciales Beaches and Grace Bay Beach, Villa Renaissance is also conveniently located near the Regent Village Shopping Mall.

name: The Atrium Resort
description: The Resort is a luxury gated hotel/condo resort located on Governor's Road (continuation of Grace Bay Road past Leeward gates) in the prominent gated community of Leeward in Providenciales, Turks and Caicos. The Resort being a condo-style hotel/resort enhances the guest's stay as they experience more privacy and tranquility and feel like they are right at home. Shuttle free from the hotel to the beach. We set up umbrellas and loungers. All units are designed with dark wood cabinets, stainless steel appliances, granite/marble countertops, and travertine floors throughout. All units feature ceiling fans and central air conditioning, ensuring personal comfort and control. There is a laptop-compatible safe in each unit, as well as a flat screen LCD television. Guests can travel light since all units feature a front-load washer and dryer, as well as an iron and ironing board. We are going to be renovating our pool and hot tub, and these two amenities will be closed on September 1, 2025 to October 31, 2025. The property will still remain open and other amenities (gym, etc. ) are open.

You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 outdoor swimming pools, outdoor tennis courts, and a health club. Additional amenities at this resort include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Guests can catch a ride on the complimentary shuttle, which operates within 1 miles. Grab a bite to eat at Cabana Bar and Grille, one of the resort's many dining establishments, which include 2 restaurants and a coffee shop/cafe. Relax with a refreshing drink at the beach bar, the poolside bar, or one of 2 bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. name: West Bay Club
description: The West Bay Club graces the widest stretch of award-winning Grace Bay Beach on Providenciales, in the Turks and Caicos. Less than 10 miles from the airport, it's conveniently located just one mile from Turtle Cove Marina and a mere 1. 5 miles from the shopping, dining, and entertainment of Grace Bay. This luxury boutique oceanfront resort offers contemporary Caribbean luxury in each of its rooms, set against the soothing backdrop of crystal-clear turquoise waters and pristine white sand. Guests can enjoy two on-site restaurants and bars, a spa, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and a free-form swimming pool.

name: Royal West Indies Resort
description: This opulent beachfront resort boasts an unbeatable setting on the stunning Grace Bay Beach in the picturesque Turks and Caicos. The pristine sandy beach, caressed by the Atlantic Ocean, and swaying palm trees are just steps away, offering an oasis of serenity for those seeking relaxation. This outstanding complex showcases a wide array of magnificent accommodations, including spacious yet cozy studios, as well as one and two-bedroom apartments. Each unit is furnished in colonial style, featuring dark wood furniture and modern amenities to guarantee guests' utmost comfort. Some units offer scenic views of the ocean or the lush gardens. Guests can dine on delectable dishes and enjoy a wide selection of drinks at the signature restaurant and bar. A range of leisure activities are available, including nearby tennis courts and water sports such as scuba diving and snorkeling, as well as boat trips and deep-sea or reef fishing. Those wishing to unwind can enjoy in-room massages offered by a partner spa. Please be advised that Pelican Bay Restaurant located at the Royal West Indies will be closed for breakfast starting Aug 25, 2025 until Sunday October 19, 2025. Hours of operation during this time at Pelican Bay Restaurant will be opening at 12pm till 10PM (9pm last seating).

name: Ports of Call Resort
description: The Ports of Call Resort is located within the beautiful Grace Bay area on Providenciales, an island of the Turks and Caicos, and is only a short 15-minute drive from the Providenciales airport (PLS). The property comprises of a central building featuring a welcoming reception, business center, breakfast room, fitness room, and poolside bar. Ports of Call Resort has 98 fully renovated deluxe junior suites surrounding a tropical pool area that creates an intimate boutique setting. For Guest's enjoyment, the tropical outdoor facilities include a poolside bar and lounge, table tennis, billiard table, pool, hot tub, comfortable chaise lounges, patio seating, shade umbrellas, towels, and a dedicated children's play area. Ports of Call Resort has a designated beach access to the awe-inspiring Grace Bay Beach complete with lounges, umbrellas, stand up paddle-boards and kayaks, and is only 300 yards from the property. A shuttle runs each hour and beach towels are provided. The property also includes the Shops of Ports of Call. The plaza offers a variety of restaurants, bars, gift and clothing shops, as well as a spa, hair salon, ice cream parlor, dive shop, conference space, fishing charter, and auto/scooter rentals. Wifi is available throughout the property, and continental breakfast is served daily.

name: Ocean Club West
description: Pamper yourself with massages, body treatments, and facials at Ocean Club West. This resort offers recreational opportunities including outdoor tennis courts, a refreshing outdoor pool, and a fitness center. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services. Savor delicious meals at Solana restaurant, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, the poolside bar, or one of the two beach bars. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee (7:00 AM to 11:00 AM). For business needs, a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and luggage storage are provided. The resort also features 1, 300 square feet of event space, ideal for conferences and meetings. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 86 air-conditioned rooms offer private balconies or patios, refrigerators, microwaves, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable TV. Bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Located near Grace Bay Beach and Princess Alexandra National Park, Ocean Club West is a short distance from attractions like The Regent Village Shopping Mall and Salt Mills Plaza. Providenciales International Airport (PLS) is approximately 12 km away.

name: The Regent Grand
description: Situated on 300 feet of pristine white sand along Grace Bay, The Regent Grand offers air-conditioned suites. Guests enjoy complimentary in-suite coffee, tea, and water, along with Wi-Fi, tennis, bicycles, access to the Nautilus fitness center, lounges, towels, umbrellas, airport greetings, private in-suite check-in with rum punch, and luggage storage. This resort also features a year-round outdoor infinity pool with two Jacuzzis and a private beach area. Guest suites include flat-panel TVs, fully equipped kitchens, and oversized balconies or terraces. Washer/dryers are available in all suites except Studios.

name: The Palms Turks and Caicos
description: Located on the banks of the beautiful Grace Bay, overlooking its crystal turquoise waters and surrounded by many palm trees, this distinguished hotel offers an authentic paradise retreat and is ranked as the top hotel in the Turks and Caicos Islands. The resort welcomes its guests in a world of luxury, with tastefully-appointed rooms and state-of-the-art facilities to ensure an unforgettable stay. The accommodation units range from stylish guest rooms to more luxurious suites, all equipped with elegant furniture, premium bedding and modern comforts. Guests may spend their day by the gorgeous infinity pool, while enjoying delicious appetizers and refreshing cocktails, without having to move or leave the pool. Stylish restaurants, an acclaimed spa with a huge variety of treatments and a well-equipped fitness centre complete the resort's facilities and ensure guests will enjoy a unique experience.

name: Rock House
description: Nestled on the world-renowned Grace Bay Beach, just an 8-minute drive from Providenciales International Airport, Rock House Resort offers an exclusive retreat. This 46-room private resort blends seamlessly with the rugged coastline, boasting unsurpassed ocean views and secluded tranquility. Inspired by the allure of the South of France, Capri, and the Mediterranean, the resort features a dramatic private beach, an exclusive beach club, a 100-foot infinity-edge pool perched on a 25-foot limestone cliff, and diverse dining options. Check-in is at 3:00 pm, and check-out is at 11:00 am.

name: One ON Marlin-Adults only retreat
description: Nestled in Providenciales' Sacred Valley, an 8-minute drive from world-famous Grace Bay Beach, One on Marlin is a discreet, contemporary boutique resort exclusively for adults. Designed to evoke tranquility and harmony, this retreat offers a unique opportunity for reconnection and rejuvenation. Each luxuriously appointed VillaSuite is nestled within indigenous botanical gardens, providing a private sanctuary. Enjoy in-suite check-in, a fully equipped kitchen, and the option of a rental car to explore the island's diverse beaches. Alternatively, unwind at our private Beach Club on Grace Bay. One on Marlin caters to adult singles, couples, and groups seeking a revitalizing escape. Reserve your exclusive getaway today.

name: Kokomo Botanical Resort-Caribbean Family Cottages
description: Escape to Kokomo Botanical Resort, a tranquil Caribbean family cottage retreat nestled in private botanical gardens just a 5-minute drive from world-famous Grace Bay Beach in the Turks & Caicos Islands. Ranked among the top 10 resorts on TripAdvisor with a Certificate of Excellence five years running, Kokomo offers a luxurious off-the-grid experience. Choose from 30+ private two-bedroom cottages ideal for families and groups, featuring personalized service and executive housekeeping. Enjoy casual days exploring our nature trail or lounging at our exclusive Grace Bay Beach Club. Take a refreshing dip in our freshwater pool and savor a local beer or handcrafted cocktail. Evenings offer a more formal atmosphere with fine dining under the stars at our on-site WE GRILL + WOK/WINE BAR.

name: Sailrock Resort - Ocean view Villas and Suites
description: Located in Cockburn Harbour, Sailrock Resort - Oceanview Villas & Suites is by the ocean, within a 5-minute drive of Long Cay Beach and Highland House. This 5-star hotel is 0. 1 mi (0. 1 km) from The Boiling Hole and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from Long Beach. Take advantage of recreation opportunities including an outdoor pool and a 24-hour fitness center. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and babysitting/childcare (surcharge). Featured amenities include a computer station, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and multilingual staff. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary during limited hours. Enjoy international cuisine at Great House Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 17 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring microwaves and flat-screen televisions. Your pillowtop bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Rooms have private balconies or patios. Cable programming and iPod docking stations are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and complimentary toiletries.

name: Villa del Mar
description: Internationally recognized as one of the world's top 10 beaches. Villa del Mar integrates indoor and outdoor living with a list of superior features and amenities that pamper you at every turn. Even the weather co-operates, providing 350 days of sunshine each year. Villa del Mar is a sanctuary of sophistication close to the very best that Provo has to offer. You'll enjoy fine dining, a full service casino, great shopping, luxurious spas, golf, fishing and water sports.

name: The Tuscany
description: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find an outdoor pool, a spa tub, and an outdoor tennis court. This aparthotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Take advantage of the aparthotel's room service (during limited hours). Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 30 air-conditioned rooms featuring kitchens with full-sized refrigerators/freezers and stovetops. Your pillowtop bed comes with premium bedding. Rooms have private balconies. Plasma televisions with cable programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. name: The Venetian On Grace Bay
description: Indulge in relaxing massages and facials at The Venetian on Grace Bay, a beachfront aparthotel in Providenciales. Enjoy amenities including an outdoor pool, fitness center, and bicycle rentals. Complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and supervised childcare are also available. Each of the 27 air-conditioned rooms features a kitchen with a refrigerator and dishwasher, a private patio, and a safe and desk. Housekeeping is provided daily. The aparthotel is steps from Lucayan Archipelago and an 8-minute walk from Providenciales Beaches. Grace Bay Beach is 0. 4 miles away, and Leeward Beach is 1. 2 miles away. Providenciales International Airport (PLS) is 8. 5 miles from the property.

Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. name: Point Grace Resort
description: Point Grace, a boutique beach retreat, is nestled on the world-renowned 12-mile Grace Bay in the Turks and Caicos Islands. Its pristine white sand beach and aquamarine waters create a breathtaking backdrop for your arrival, whether by yacht or air. A tropical cocktail sets the tone for your stay. For arrivals through May 1, 2020, cancellations are permitted up to 24 hours prior to arrival, with deposits held for future travel through December 31, 2020. COVID-19 Measures: * Guests (excluding children under 10) must provide a negative RT-PCR nasal swab test taken within five days of arrival. * Travel insurance covering COVID-19 medical treatment, quarantine costs, and repatriation is mandatory. * Proof of negative test results and insurance must be uploaded to the TCI Assured website for entry approval. * Enhanced cleaning protocols are in place throughout the resort.

name: Inn at Grace Bay
description: When you stay at this aparthotel in Providenciales, you'll be in a shopping district, within a 5-minute walk of Grace Bay Beach and Salt Mills Plaza. This aparthotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from The Regent Village Shopping Mall and 2. 1 mi (3. 4 km) from Leeward Beach. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor pool or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional amenities at this aparthotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a picnic area. Featured amenities include laundry facilities and coffee/tea in a common area. Free self parking is available onsite. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM. Make yourself comfortable in this apartment, featuring a kitchen with a full-sized refrigerator/freezer and an oven. Your bed comes with a down comforter and Egyptian cotton sheets. There's a private patio. A flat-screen television with cable programming provides entertainment, while complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected.

name: Alexandra Resort - All-Inclusive
description: The all-inclusive Alexandra Resort features a beach front location directly on Grace Bay Beach, spacious studios and suites and all-inclusive amenities and services. With its expansive, lush grounds, the 90-suite Alexandra Resort is one of the larger resorts on Grace Bay Beach, where customer service is paramount. Here guests will enjoy personal service from attentive and friendly staff who strive to make everyone feel welcome. The resort's spacious suites are distinguished by high ceilings and large decks or patios. The experience of staying at Alexandra Resort is a unique one. Resort amenities include a large lagoon-style swimming pool, five restaurants, a spa, 24-hour front desk, an exercise room, non-motorized water sports, tennis courts, bicycles and Wi-Fi property wide. The all-inclusive program features the stay at one, play at three experience with Alexandra Resort's sister resorts, Blue Haven Resort and Beach House (adults only). Together they feature eleven restaurants, eleven bars, two spas and a spa cabana, a kids club, complimentary shuttle and dine around.

name: Blue Haven Resort - All Inclusive
description: The all-inclusive Blue Haven Resort is ideally sized for couples, families, solo travelers, and wedding groups to enjoy the resort with all its amenities. All studios and suites are spacious, modern and beautifully maintained and the beach and grounds are stunning with many palm trees, grasses and bright tropical flowers to enjoy. Blue Haven Resort occupies a long stretch of waterfront on the north eastern end of Providenciales so even when the hotel is full, it is always easy to find yourself a peaceful spot to escape, unwind and take in the beautiful surroundings.Blue Haven Resort is directly affiliated with Blue Haven Marina, providing easy access to all your favorite water sports and activities. When you return from a day of marine adventure, take advantage of our many land-based amenities. Relax at Elevate Spa; burn some calories at the gym; swim in our infinity-edged pool with swim-up bar or simply have a nap in one of the hammocks on the resort's private beach; play beach volleyball, beach tennis, horseshoes, or even a game of oversize chess; shop for grocery items, snacks and barista coffees at the MARKET; mingle with the marina guests, crew and residents during the daily happy hour at Salt Bar & Grill; indulge in an amazing meal at Fire & Ice Restaurant. The all-inclusive program features the stay at one, play at three experience with Blue Haven Resort's sister resorts, Alexandra Resort and Beach House (adults only). Together they feature eleven restaurants, eleven bars, two spas and a spa cabana, a kids club, complimentary shuttle and dine around.

description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. After dipping into one of the 2 outdoor swimming pools, you can spend some time at the private beach. Additional features at this resort include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Pan-Asian cuisine at Lotus, one of the resort's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in Parrot Cay? This resort has 660 square feet (61 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. For a surcharge, guests may use a roundtrip airport shuttle (available on request) and a ferry terminal shuttle.
